expectations.text: Flags the nested comments and attachments resolvers as unscoped by tenant
expectations.evidence: "Nested queries can leak data if the parent Document object is retrieved via an unscoped path (like the vulnerable search or update)" in Proposed Changes section

expectations.text: Flags updateDocument for scoping on id alone without a tenant constraint
expectations.evidence: "Currently vulnerable to IDOR. Users can modify (and likely read via response) any document by its ID."

expectations.text: Flags exportWorkspace taking tenantId from the client-controlled request body
expectations.evidence: "Currently takes tenantId from req.body and passes it unsafely to SQL"

expectations.text: Flags searchDocuments as returning rows across all tenants
Flags adminListDocuments as checking authentication but not authorization or tenant
expectations.evidence: "It currently lacks both an admin role check and a tenant scope constraint" in Open Questions section

expectations.text: Enumerates all the affected sites rather than fixing only the first one found
expectations.evidence: Addresses updateDocument, exportWorkspace, searchDocuments, nested resolvers, and adminListDocuments

expectations.text: Recommends a structural device (scoped repository, row-level security, or equivalent) rather than only adding where-clauses site by site
expectations.evidence: Proposes only specific function-level fixes and parameterized queries; no architectural pattern recommended

expectations.text: Recommends a cross-tenant test that attempts tenant A operations against tenant B resources
expectations.evidence: "Call updateDocument using a session for Tenant A and a documentId for Tenant B. Ensure it fails"

expectations.text: Identifies the raw interpolation of tenantId into $queryRawUnsafe as an injection hazard distinct in kind from the tenant-scoping bug
expectations.evidence: "SQL Injection: In exportWorkspace, the tenantId is directly interpolated into db.$queryRawUnsafe. This is a severe SQL injection vulnerability on top of the broken access control" — identifies as distinct and additional

expectations.text: Does not conclude the main query paths being scoped means the service is safe
expectations.evidence: "While the main getDocument query is scoped properly, several other paths bypass tenant isolation"
